payload.title: Use catalog effects in a narrated Babulus production
payload.description:
## Behavior
As a Babulus author, I can combine VideoML catalog effects with Babulus voiceover.

## Acceptance scenarios
Given a Babulus narrated fixture using shared effects, when voiceover timing changes, then supported cue-relative visuals follow correctly and preview/export remain consistent. Verify against actual package manifests rather than stale alias instructions, and document the package boundary and migration. No voiceover service is required for the separate VideoML catalog checks.

## Ownership
toolchain, videoml-org, player; Babulus integration

## Evidence
Link implementation, runnable fixtures, and verification results before closing. Keep product-boundary decisions in the parent initiative.
